ui.OuDormezVousLeJourQui: Where do you sleep by day? Who knows it?
ui.QuiYVitCeQuOn: Who lives there, what can be found there…

ui.EditionLibreLesChangementsDePoints: Free editing: dot changes are not written to the log.

ui.AugmenterUneVertuAvecDeL: * Raising a Virtue with XP does not raise the traits derived from it. No trait may gain more than one dot per story.
ui.GlissezIciUnActeurPnjAutre: Drag an actor here (NPC, another character) to link it, or add a free entry. The counters compare your entries with your Allies, Contacts, Mentor, Retainers and Herd Backgrounds.
ui.LienDeSang1reGorgeeAttachement: Blood bond: 1st drink = intermittent attachment; 2nd = the regnant becomes a priority (Willpower roll to harm them, −1 to their social rolls against the thrall); 3rd = enthralled
ui.CeQuIlVousApporteCe: What they give you, what they ask in return…
ui.CeQueJePenseDesAutres: What I think of the other characters
ui.VotreAvisVosDettesVosSoupcons: Your opinion, your debts, your suspicions…
ui.LienDeSangEntreVosDeux: Blood bond between your two characters
ui.AucunAutrePersonnageJoueurDansCe: No other player character in this world.
ui.CesNotesSeTrouventSurVotre: These notes are on your sheet: only you and the GM can see them, unless you let other players view your sheet.
ui.CesReglesSontChoisiesParLe: These rules are chosen by the Storyteller for the whole chronicle; they apply automatically to rolls and combat cards.
ui.AucuneVarianteLaChroniqueSuitLes: No variants: the chronicle follows the core rules.
ui.GuideOuLibreOuRemplissezLa: (guided or free), or fill the sheet by hand then click the hourglass.
ui.ReglesEnVigueurDansCetteChronique: Rules in effect in this chronicle: {length} active variant(s)
ui.RevelerAuxJoueursMessageDansLe: Reveal to the players (message in chat)
ui.JusquAuProchainCoucherDuSoleil: Until the next sunset: dawn, a day of sleep, vampires awaken
ui.ReglerLaDateEtLHeure: Set the date and time with no effect
ui.EvenementsPreparesPasEncoreRevelesAux: Prepared events, not yet revealed to the players
ui.PlacerLaChroniqueACetteDate: Move the chronicle to this date (no effect)
ui.AucunEvenementCreezEnDepuisLe: No events. Create some from the calendar: they stay hidden until you reveal them.
ui.LaChroniqueNAEncoreRien: The chronicle has recorded nothing yet. Events will appear here as the storyteller reveals them, and you can add your own memories.
ui.AucuneLigneeTrouveeCreezVosLignees: No clan found. Create your clans, disciplines and Roads in the Items tab (or import a compendium), then reopen the creator.
ui.LaCreationSeFaitEnCinq: Creation takes five steps: a concept, Attributes, Abilities, Advantages, then finishing touches and freebie points. Choose how you want to proceed.
ui.PasAPasChaqueChoixEst: Step by step. Every choice is explained, points left are counted, and you can only move on once the step is valid.
ui.PourLeConteurOuUnJoueur: For the storyteller or an experienced player: same screens, no limits or checks. Every discipline is offered. Ideal for an NPC or an elder.
ui.QuiEtaitVotrePersonnageDeSon: Who was your character in life? Why did their sire choose them? What do they do with their nights? Concept, clan and Road set the tone for everything else.
ui.LaNatureEstLaPersonnaliteProfonde: Nature is the true personality: acting according to it regains Willpower. Demeanor is the mask shown to the world.
ui.LaVoieEstLaMoraleQui: The Road is the morality that holds the Beast back. It sets your first two Virtues: Conscience or Conviction, Self-Control or Instinct.
ui.ChaqueAttributCommenceA1Point: Every Attribute starts at 1 dot. Rank the categories by importance: 7 points for primary, 5 for secondary, 3 for tertiary.
ui.ForceDexteriteVigueurPourLeCorps: Strength, Dexterity, Stamina for the body; Charisma, Manipulation, Appearance for relationships; Perception, Intelligence, Wits for the mind.
ui.ClassezTalentsCompetencesEtConnaissances: Rank Talents, Skills and Knowledges: 13, 9 and 5 points. No Ability may exceed 3 at this stage (freebie points will let you go higher).
ui.GenerationAbaisseVotreGeneration12ePar: Generation lowers your generation (12th by default); Domain and Herd fill your starting blood pool.
ui.ChaqueVertuCommenceA1Les: Every Virtue starts at 1. The first two (depending on your Road) give your Road rating; Courage gives your Willpower.
ui.UnNiveauDeVoieDe5: A Road rating of 5 to 7 is common: the vampire has chosen a direction without throwing themselves into it yet. Low Willpower leaves one open to temptation; freebie points can raise it.
ui.HandicapsEnRapportent7AuMaximum: Flaws give some back (7 at most). For those with several levels, click the level you want: its effect is shown below.
ui.PlusGagnesParVosHandicaps7: , plus {flawGain} earned from your Flaws (7 at most)
ui.CoutsAttribut5Capacite2Discipline: . Costs: Attribute 5, Ability 2, discipline 7, Background 1, Virtue 2, Road 2, Willpower 1. Merits chosen in the previous step are already deducted.
ui.DepensesEnTraitsEnAtoutsReste: Spent: {bonusSpent} on traits + {meritCost} on Merits — left
ui.CopieToutLeContenuDuMonde: Copies all the world's content into a compendium, to reuse or share it
ui.CompendiumCopiezLeDansLeMonde: Compendium: copy it into the world to edit it
ui.RienPourLInstantCreezVotre: Nothing yet. Create your first entry with the buttons above.
ui.LeCreateurDePersonnageEtLes: The character creator and the sheets read everything found here: world items and compendiums. Clans, disciplines and paths are linked through each discipline's key (taken from its name unless you change it).
ui.ExSeance12LaChuteDe: e.g. Session 12 — the fall of Brno
ui.CochezLesPersonnagesConcernesLaColonne: Tick the characters concerned; the “Bonus” column adds or removes points for a single character (roleplay, heroics…).
ui.AucunPersonnageNEstMarquePj: No character is marked “PC”: the list shows actors that have a player. Click the PC button at the top of each sheet to fix the list.
ui.RetirerCetteDistributionDesFiches: Remove this award from the sheets
ui.ExChasseAuPortCaliceDu: e.g. Hunt at the docks, herd chalice, the Prince's feast…
ui.LesReservesRestentBorneesEntre0: Pools stay between 0 and the generation's maximum. Each line's − / + buttons adjust without a message.
ui.AucunPersonnageNEstMarquePj2: No character is marked “PC”: the list shows actors that have a player.
ui.AucunPersonnageJoueurNeSeNourrit: No player character feeds on blood (vampires and ghouls).
ui.InstinctUnVampireQuiSuitL: Instinct: a vampire who follows Instinct always gives in to frenzy.
ui.PourEmpecherUnActeAuthentiquementMalefiq: To prevent a truly evil act: difficulty 9 − Conscience/Conviction
ui.RetenirSonCoupNiveauxDeDegats: Pull the blow: damage levels halved, rounded up
ui.ResultatMoyenDuPnjSansJet: NPC average result, no roll: {pool} dice ÷ 2 = {successes}
ui.ApresAbsorptionNeSubirQueLa: After soaking, take only half the levels (rounded up)
ui.Depense1PointDeVolonte1: Spend 1 Willpower point: 1 automatic soak success (variant)
ui.1PointDeVolonte1Reussite: 1 Willpower point (+1 success), then half the remaining levels
ui.AppliqueAuxJetonsCiblesTOu: Applies to targeted (T) or selected tokens, with their soak roll
ui.AucunJetonDeSurLaScene: No token of {name} on the scene: place it to pick a target.
ui.ViserUnePartiePreciseDuCorps: Aim at a precise body part or a chink in the armor
ui.DeFlanc1DeDeDos: From the flank: +1 die · from behind: +2 dice
ui.CouvertDeLaCibleDifficulte1: Target's cover: difficulty +1 to +3 to hit
ui.1DeParTourPasseA: +1 die per turn spent aiming, up to Perception ({perception}); move no faster than a walk
ui.1EnDifficulteParAdversaireAu: +1 difficulty per opponent beyond the first, up to +4
ui.LaCibleSeDefendSiElle: The target defends if it can (cost depends on the variants), then damage and soak follow in a summary card.
ui.VolonteDepensee1ReussiteAutomatique1: Willpower spent: +1 automatic success <small>(1 per turn at most · {willpowerTemp} left)</small>
ui.FaiblesseMecaniqueLXpDeConscience: Mechanical weakness: XP for Conscience/Conviction and Road costs double
ui.IdentifiantQuiRelieClansVoiesEt: Identifier linking clans, paths and sheets. Leave empty: it is taken from the name ({discKey}).
ui.SiLaDisciplineTientLUn: If the discipline fills one of these roles, its dots apply automatically (actions, soak, Strength).
ui.TorcheBrandonHuileEnflammeeAvecLa: Torch, firebrand, burning oil… With the variant, armor does not soak this damage.
ui.FacultatifPourUnAtoutOuUn: Optional. For a Merit or Flaw with several levels (e.g. a more or less powerful rival): the character creator will offer each level with its text and cost.
ui.BonusProposesDansLaFenetreDe: Bonuses offered in the roll window
ui.ExSensCommun1DeQuand: E.g. Common Sense: +1 die when the storyteller allows it; clan weakness: +2 difficulty against frenzy (“auto” = ticked by default when the target matches).

js.ChaquePointDeSangDepenseDonne:
Each blood point spent grants one extra action this turn, without multiple-action penalties; at most half (rounded up) of these actions may be attacks.

Each Celerity dot used this way no longer adds to Dexterity rolls and initiative this turn.

{rows}
js.CoupStandardAvecLArmeDexterite: Standard blow with the weapon. Dexterity + Melee, normal difficulty, weapon damage.
js.1DiffDegats2PasDe: +1 diff. · damage +2 · no defense this turn
js.TouteLaForceDansLeCoup: All your strength in the blow: difficulty +1, normal damage +2. The attacker can take no defensive action this turn.
js.FaireTrebucherLAdversaireAvecL: Trip the opponent with the weapon (staff, whip…): difficulty +1, weapon damage, and the target falls if the attack hits. A staff gives +2 dice to sweep.
js.1DiffArmeArracheeSiDegats: +1 diff. · weapon torn away if damage > Strength
js.ViserLArmeAdverseDifficulte1: Aim at the opponent's weapon: difficulty +1. Roll damage: if the successes exceed the target's Strength, they take no damage but their weapon flies as many meters as the difference. Otherwise they take the damage normally.
js.EnfoncerUnPieuDansLaPoitrine: Drive a stake into a vampire's chest: difficulty +3, weapon damage. If at least 3 levels remain after soak, the heart is pierced: the vampire is immobilized (a human dies).
js.ContreAttaqueApresUneDefenseReussie: Counterattack after a successful defense this turn, using the opponent's momentum: difficulty +1 (on top of multiple-action penalties), normal damage +1. The target defends at difficulty +2.
js.AttaqueDeBaseAMainsNues: Basic unarmed attack: Dexterity + Brawl, normal difficulty, Strength damage (bashing).
js.PlusDeDegatsQuUnCoup: More damage than a punch but harder: Dexterity + Brawl, difficulty +1, Strength + 1 damage (bashing).
js.1DiffForce2PasDe: +1 diff. · Strength + 2 · no defense this turn
js.TouteLaForceDansLeCoup2: All your strength in the blow: difficulty +1, Strength + 2 damage. The attacker can take no defensive action this turn.
js.FaucherLesJambesDeLAdversaire: Sweep the opponent's legs: Dexterity + Brawl, difficulty +1, Strength damage (bashing), and the target falls if the attack hits.
js.PourDesGriffesSurnaturellesOuCelles: For supernatural claws or a beast's: Dexterity + Brawl, Strength + 1 damage, aggravated (supernatural claws). For ordinary claws, create a Brawl weapon with lethal damage instead.
js.AgripperLaCibleForceBagarreDegats: Grab the target: Strength + Brawl, Strength damage. Both fighters are then locked in the grapple: they may inflict their Strength in damage or try to break free (opposed Strength + Brawl); no other physical action.
js.RetenirLaCibleJusquASa: Hold the target until its next action: Strength + Brawl, difficulty +1, no damage. To act, the victim must win an opposed Strength + Brawl roll.
js.SeJeterSurLAdversaireForce: Throw yourself at the opponent: Strength + Brawl, difficulty +1, Strength + 1 damage. Both fighters roll Dexterity + Athletics (difficulty 7): on a failure, they fall. Even on a success, they have +1 difficulty next turn.
js.ApresUneEmpoignadeUneSaisieOu: After a successful clinch, hold or tackle, bite the next turn: Dexterity + Brawl + 1, Strength + 1 aggravated damage, without the ecstasy of the Kiss.
js.1DeAucunDegat3Points: +1 die · no damage · 3 blood points per turn
js.ApresUneEmpoignadeUneSaisieOu2: After a successful clinch, hold or tackle: the bite deals no damage but the Kiss plunges the victim into ecstasy, and the vampire drinks 3 blood points per turn (within the limit of their pool).
js.ContreAttaqueApresUneDefenseReussie2: Counterattack after a successful defense this turn: difficulty +1 (on top of multiple-action penalties), Strength + 1 damage. The target defends at difficulty +2.
js.TirOuLancerStandardDexteriteTir: Standard shot or throw: Dexterity + Archery (Athletics for thrown weapons). Beyond the weapon's range: difficulty +1 up to double, +2 up to triple.
js.CommeLePieuUnLongTrait: Like the stake: a long wooden shaft through the heart. Difficulty +3, weapon damage; if at least 3 levels remain after soak, the vampire is immobilized.
js.UneSalveAuxPiedsDUn: A volley at the feet of an advancing enemy (Archery 3 minimum, medium or long range, never as a multiple action). If they keep advancing: the archer's difficulty −2, and their defense is at difficulty +2.
js.NormaleUneFlecheParPointDe: Normal · one arrow per Archery dot
js.LArcherEntraineTireAutantDe: The trained archer shoots as many arrows as they have Archery dots, using the multiple-action rules (choose the action number below). Aiming only counts for the first shot.
js.AttaqueSansViserDePartiePrecise: Attack without aiming at a precise part.

js.VosGestesSemblentDefierLeRegard: Your movements seem to defy the eye.

js.VousPlaisezACeuxQuiVous: Those who know you like you.

js.VosIntentionsSeLisentSurVotre: Your intentions are written on your face.
js.VousSavezQuelLevierActionner: You know which lever to pull.
js.VousRetournezUnAdversaireEnUne: You turn an opponent around in one conversation.
js.LesGensVousServentEnCroyant: People serve you believing they act for themselves.
js.BeauteAllureEtImpressionProduiteAu: Beauty, bearing and the impression made at first glance.

js.VousLisezLesDetailsCommeUn: You read details like a book.
js.VosSensFrolentLeSurnaturel: Your senses border on the supernatural.
js.MemoireRaisonnementEtSavoirSertA: Memory, reasoning and knowledge. Used to understand, deduce and learn.
js.PresenceDEspritEtRapiditeDe: Presence of mind and speed of reaction. Counts toward initiative.
js.VousReagissezAPeuPresA: You react more or less in time.
js.VousSemblezAvoirPrevuChaqueSurprise: You seem to have foreseen every surprise.
js.ParmiLesMeilleursDeLaRegion: Among the best in the region.
js.UneReferenceQueLOnVient: An authority people come from afar to consult.
js.VolALaTireToursDe: Pickpocketing, sleight of hand, lockpicking and hiding objects.

js.CombatSansArmeCoupsPrisesLutte: Unarmed combat: blows, holds, grappling and bites.
js.DonnerDesOrdresInspirerTenirUne: Giving orders, inspiring, keeping a troop together in adversity.
js.ComprendreLesEmotionsDAutruiEt: Understanding others' emotions and guessing their intentions.
js.SExprimerAvecForceEtJustesse: Expressing oneself with power and precision, in writing as in speech.
js.FairePlierParLaMenaceLa: Making others yield through threats, presence or fear.
js.PressentirLeDangerEtSentirL: Sensing danger and feeling the strange, the supernatural.
js.MentirTromperCacherSesButsEt: Lying, deceiving, hiding one's aims and seeing through others'.
js.ResterSurSesGardesRemarquerCe: Staying on guard, noticing what's wrong.
js.FabriquerEtReparerForgeMenuiserieCouture: Making and mending: smithing, carpentry, sewing, masonry…
js.MonterDirigerEtCombattreACheval: Riding, guiding and fighting on horseback.
js.ConnaitreLesUsagesDesCoursEt: Knowing the customs of courts and circles, and behaving flawlessly there.
js.SeDeplacerSansEtreVuNi: Moving without being seen or heard.
js.CombatAvecArmesBlanchesEpeesHaches: Fighting with hand weapons: swords, axes, spears, staves.
js.ChanterJouerDanserConterDevantUn: Singing, playing, dancing, storytelling before an audience.
js.VivreEtSeDirigerEnPleine: Living and finding one's way in the wild, tracking, hunting.
js.ConnaitreLoisCoutumesEtProceduresEt: Knowing laws, customs and procedures, and using them.
js.SavoirDesLettresHistoirePhilosophieLangu: Book learning: history, philosophy, learned languages.
js.ChercherDesIndicesInterrogerReconstituer: Looking for clues, questioning, reconstructing events.
js.SoignerLesBlessuresEtLesMaladies: Treating wounds and illness, knowing the body.
js.SavoirCeQuOnRaconteDu: Knowing what is said of the supernatural, telling legend from truth.
js.ComprendreLesJeuxDePouvoirEt: Understanding power games and taking part in them.
js.LeSavoirDesGensSimplesRemedes: The lore of common folk: remedies, omens, customs and superstitions.
js.GererUnDomaineUneMaisonDes: Running an estate, a household, people and revenues.
js.ConnaitreLesDogmesLesTextesEt: Knowing the dogmas, texts and people of the faith.
js.DesMortelsQuiVousAidentDe: Mortals who help you of their own free will. They have their own lives and sometimes expect something in return.
js.TroisAlliesDontUnInfluent: Three allies, one of them influential.
js.QuatreAlliesDontUnTresInfluent: Four allies, one of them very influential.
js.CinqAlliesDontUnPuissantPersonnage: Five allies, one of them a powerful figure.

js.UneVilleEntiereOuUneContree: A whole city or a region.

js.UneIdentiteQuiTientUneEnquete: An identity that survives a quick inquiry.
js.UneIdentiteSolideConnueDansLa: A solid identity, known in the region.

js.UneVoixQuOnEcouteParfois: A voice people sometimes listen to.
js.UnNotableDUnePetiteVille: A notable in a small town.
js.UnPouvoirQuiCompteDansLa: Power that counts in the region.
js.OnNeDecideRienDImportant: Nothing important is decided without you.
js.UnAineQuiVousGuideVous: An elder who guides you, advises you and sometimes protects you.
js.UnNomQuOnCiteDans: A name spoken across the region.
js.LAisanceDUnArtisanProspere: The comfort of a prosperous craftsman.
js.DesServiteursFidelesSouventLiesPar: Loyal servants, often bound by blood: guards, valets, spies.
js.VotreRangDansLaSocieteDes: Your rank in the vampire society of your domain.
js.DesMortelsDontVousPouvezBoire: Mortals whose blood you can drink without hunting. Adds dice to feeding.
js.LeSensMoralDistinguerLeBien: Moral sense: telling right from wrong and feeling remorse. Used to resist degeneration.
js.UnVagueMalaiseApresLesPires: A vague unease after the worst deeds.
js.LaFermeteDUnePhilosophieQui: The firmness of a philosophy that does not pass through compassion: one acts by one's principles, whatever the cost.
js.LaMaitriseDeLaBeteResister: Mastery of the Beast: resisting hunger, rage and frenzy.
js.LaMoindreProvocationVousEmporte: The slightest provocation sets you off.
js.VousTenezLaPlupartDuTemps: You hold on most of the time.
js.IlEnFautBeaucoupPourVous: It takes a lot to make you lose your footing.

js.VousLEcoutezSansLaComprendre: You listen to it without understanding it.

js.AuBordDeLAbime: On the edge of the abyss.
js.VotreMoraleHumaniteOuAutreVoie: Your morality (Humanity or another Road). The higher it is, the better you resist the Beast; it drops when you sin against its hierarchy.
js.ForceDeCaractereDepenser1Point: Strength of character. Spending 1 Willpower point gives an automatic success or lets you ignore wounds for a moment.
js.PouvoirSurnaturelDeVotreSangOuvrez: A supernatural power of your blood. Open the discipline's sheet to read its powers.
js.LivreChaqueDefenseEsquiveParadeBlocage: Core rule: each defense (dodge, parry, block) costs one action of the turn. Reflexive defense: the first defense each turn is free, later ones cost an action. Defense for a die: defending never costs an action, but each defense removes 1 die from the character's next attack.
js.LivreChaqueDefenseCouteUneAction: Core rule: each defense costs an action
js.DefenseReflexe1reDefenseDuTour: Reflexive defense: 1st defense of the turn free
js.DefenseAuPrixDUnDe: Defense for one die off the next attack
js.ChaqueDefenseCouteUneActionUn: Each defense costs an action. A character without Celerity who defends can no longer attack this turn.
js.LaPremiereDefenseDeChaqueTour: The first defense each turn is free. Later defenses cost one action each; with no action left, the defense counts 0 successes.
js.SeDefendreNeCoutePasD: Defending costs no action. Each defense removes 1 die from the character's next attack (cumulative, reset after that attack and at each new turn).
js.CocheUneAttaqueQuiToucheFait: Ticked: an attack that hits always deals at least 1 damage level before soak, even if the damage roll gets no success. Unticked (core rule): 0 successes, no damage.
js.UneAttaqueQuiToucheInfligeToujours: An attack that hits always inflicts at least 1 damage level before soak, even if the damage roll yields no success.
js.UnJetDeDegatsSansReussite: A damage roll with no success inflicts no damage.
js.DecocheRegleDeBaseChapitreCombat: Unticked (core rule, Combat chapter, “Damage”): only successes beyond the first add to the damage dice. Ticked: every net attack success adds.
js.ToutesLesReussitesNettesDeL: Every net attack success adds to the damage dice.
js.SeulesLesReussitesAuDelaDe: Only successes beyond the first add to the damage dice.
js.VariantePnjAuResultatMoyen: Variant: NPCs use the average result
js.CocheLesPnjNeLancentPas: Ticked: NPCs don't roll their soak or damage dice; they get the average result, i.e. half the pool rounded up. Unticked (core rule): they roll the dice.
js.LesPnjNeLancentPasL: NPCs don't roll soak or damage: they automatically get half their pool, rounded up (5 dice → 3 successes, 4 dice → 2). PCs always roll their dice.
js.LesPnjLancentLeursDesD: NPCs roll their soak and damage dice like PCs.
js.VarianteLArmureNeProtegePas: Variant: armor does not protect against fire or sunlight
js.CocheContreUneArmeOuDes: Ticked: against a weapon or damage marked “fire or sunlight”, armor adds no soak dice (Fortitude only for vampires). Unticked: armor soaks normally.
js.ContreLeFeuEtLeSoleil: Against fire and sunlight, armor adds no soak dice. Tick “Fire or sunlight” on the weapon (torch, firebrand…) or in the manual damage window.
js.LArmureAbsorbeAussiLeFeu: Armor also soaks fire and sunlight.
js.CocheUnPjPeutDepenser1: Ticked: a PC may spend 1 Willpower point on their soak roll for 1 automatic success. Unticked (core rule): Willpower is not used on soak.
js.UnPjPeutDepenser1Point: A PC may spend 1 Willpower point on a soak roll: 1 automatic success, as on an ordinary roll (button in the combat card).
js.LaVolonteNeSAjoutePas: Willpower does not add to soak.
js.UneGuerisonGratuiteParTourLa: One free heal per turn: the first heal each turn costs no action, later ones cost one. Free: never an action (blood per turn remains the only limit).
js.1GuerisonGratuiteParTourPuis: 1 free heal per turn, then 1 action each
js.DepenserDuSangPourGuerirNe: Spending blood to heal costs no action; only blood per turn limits healing.
js.LaPremiereGuerisonParLeSang: The first blood heal each turn is free. Each later heal costs an action; with no action left, no healing until the next turn.
js.CocheLInitiativeSeLanceUne: Ticked: initiative is rolled only once at the start of combat. Unticked (core rule): everyone rerolls at the start of each turn.
js.LInitiativeEstLanceeUneSeule: Initiative is rolled only once, at the start of combat; the order stays the same each turn.
js.LInitiativeDeTousLesCombattants: Every combatant's initiative is rerolled at the start of each turn.
js.CocheLesArmuresProtegentToujoursMais: Ticked: armor still protects, but no longer removes dice from Dexterity rolls or initiative.
js.LesArmuresProtegentMaisNeRetirent: Armor protects but no longer removes dice from Dexterity rolls or initiative.
js.LesArmuresRetirentDesDesAux: Armor removes dice from Dexterity rolls and initiative.
js.CocheChaque10VautDeuxReussites: Ticked: each 10 is worth two successes on every roll (except damage and soak), with or without a specialty. Unticked (core rule): only with a specialty.
js.Chaque10VautDeuxReussitesSur: Each 10 is worth two successes on every roll (except damage and soak), with or without a specialty.
js.Un10NeVautDeuxReussites: A 10 is worth two successes only with a specialty.
js.LivreChaque1AnnuleUneReussite: Core rule: each 1 cancels a success; botch if no success and at least one 1. Variant: 1s cancel nothing; botch only if more than half the dice rolled show 1.
js.VarianteEchecCritiqueSiPlusDe: Variant: botch if more than half are 1s
js.Chaque1AnnuleUneReussiteEchec: Each 1 cancels a success; botch if no success remains and at least one 1 came up.
js.Les1NAnnulentAucuneReussite: 1s cancel no success. Botch only if more than half the dice rolled show 1.
